linked.title: Linked pickers
linked.subtitle: Pickers without an account. You answer picking requests for them, once they agree by SMS.
linked.form_subtitle: We'll send the picker an SMS asking them to agree. Until they agree, you can't answer for them.
linked.need_personal: To link pickers, first add your own personal information — the picker will see your name in the SMS.
linked.empty: You have no linked pickers yet.
linked.how_1: Add the picker's details and their own mobile number.
linked.how_2: They get an SMS with a code and a link. They tell you the code, or tap the link and agree.
linked.how_3: Once they agree, you can answer picking requests for them. They can withdraw at any time from the same link.
linked.pay_own: To the picker's own bank account
linked.pay_own_text: Wages go directly to the picker.
linked.pay_me_text: Wages are paid to your account (•••• {{last4}}), and you pass them on. The picker must agree to this.
linked.iban_hint: The picker's own IBAN, e.g. GE29 NB00 0000 0101 9049 17
linked.phone_hint: The consent SMS goes to this number. It must be the picker's own phone, not yours.
linked.consent_box_title: What the picker will agree to
linked.consent_box: {{name}} agrees that {{rep}} may answer picking requests for them. Wages go to their own account.
linked.consent_box_pay: {{name}} agrees that {{rep}} may answer picking requests for them and receive their wages.
linked.consent_box_edit: Changing the phone number or payment needs a new confirmation; a new SMS is sent.
linked.confirmed_on: Agreed on {{date}} ({{method}}). You can answer picking requests for this picker.
linked.pending_help: We sent an SMS to {{phone}}. Ask the picker for the 6-digit code, or they can agree via the link in the SMS.
linked.declined_help: The picker declined. You can ask again, or remove them.
linked.revoked_help: The picker withdrew their consent on {{date}}. You can ask again, or remove them.
linked.resend_wait: Wait a minute before sending another SMS
linked.remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? Their data will be deleted and they'll get an SMS that they are no longer linked to you.

consent.request: {{rep}} is asking for your permission to act for you on FarmPlatform:
consent.scope_availability: Answer for you whether you can take part in fruit picking
consent.scope_pay_rep: Receive your wages on their account (•••• {{last4}}) and pass them on to you
consent.scope_pay_own: Your wages go to your own account (•••• {{last4}})
consent.scope_withdraw: You can withdraw this permission at any time from this page
consent.agreed: You agreed. Thank you! You can withdraw at any time.
consent.not_found_text: This link has expired or was replaced by a newer SMS. Use the link from the most recent SMS.
consent.footer: If you don't know this person, tap "I don't agree".
